Inglewood, California
  June 11, 2019

The Finance Authority of the City of Inglewood, California held a special meeting
on Tuesday, June 11, 2019, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called
the City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, Housing
Authority, Finance Authority, Parking Authority, and Joint Powers Authority at
the hour of 2:07 p.m.
The City Clerk/ Successor Agency Secretary/ Housing Authority
Secretary/Finance Authority Secretary/Parking Authority Secretary/Joint Powers
Authority Secretary announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing
  Authority Chairman/Finance Authority Chairman/

Authority, Parking Authority, and Joint Powers Authority.

PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS. Mayor/Successor Agency
Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman/Finance Authority Chairman/Parking
Authority Chairman/Joint Powers Authority Chairman Butts inquired if there
were any persons present who wished to address the City Council/Successor
Agency/Housing Authority/Finance Authority/Parking Authority/Joint Powers
Authority on any item on the Agenda.

The following persons spoke concerning CI-1, Initiative by Mayor James T.
Butts, Jr., recommending the introduction of an Ordinance amending Chapter 8
(Business, Trades, and Professions) of the Inglewood Municipal Code to add a
new Article 9 (Housing Protection Initiative) for the regulation of rent increases
and just cause evictions for certain covered residential rental units:

  FINANCE AUTHORITY MINUTES. It was moved by Finance Authority Member
  Dotson, and seconded by Finance Authority Member Morales, that the Minutes for the
  Finance Authority Meetings held on April 16, 2019, April 23, 2019, April 30, 2019, be
  approved. The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Finance Authority Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, and Finance Authority
  Chairman Butts;
  Noes: None; and
  Absent: Finance Authority Member Franklin.

  There being no further business to be presented, Finance Authority Chairman Butts
  declared the meeting adjourned in memory of Kent Taylor, former Inglewood and
  Lennox School Superintendent at the hour of 5:36 p.m.

  Approved this 16th day of July 2019
